meta.name: organic-growth-advisor
meta.description: Identify which organic growth path to pursue — new segments, geographies, channels, or products. Use when diagnosing where a growth constraint lives and which McKinsey growth level to act on next.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 判断该优先开拓哪类增长
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是增长负责人,正纠结下一步该攻哪个方向
copy.tagline_en: Identify your next organic growth path
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you lead growth and need to decide where to focus next.

howto.what: 它会用三个问题做分诊:先问你的产品与增长瓶颈,再问目标客户的熟悉程度和产品需要改多少,最后推荐四种有机增长路径中的一条,并给出理由、诊断问题、一周内可做的实验和常见陷阱。
howto.when: 描述增长约束或问该聚焦哪个增长层级时触发。适合增长停滞找不到杠杆、多路径难选、要设定增长实验初始假设时。前提是已有产品市场契合——未契合或已有路径在跑则不适用。

say.text: 我们是B2B薪酬工具,美国中端市场增长停滞,该进欧洲还是做SMB分层?
say.note: 它会先确认目标客户与产品改动幅度,再推荐一条路径。

say.text: 产品市场契合良好但增长停滞,先做新客户群还是新渠道?
say.note: 它会定位你处于哪个增长层,给出首个实验。

say.text: 我们在考虑新地区和新产品两条路,怎么判断该选哪个?
say.note: 它会用熟悉度与改动量两个轴分析。

howto.what_en: Claude runs a 3-question triage (product context, market familiarity, product change), places you on a 2x2 matrix, and recommends one of four organic growth paths (L2–L5) with rationale, diagnostic question, first experiment, and pitfall.
howto.when_en: Triggers when diagnosing a growth bottleneck or choosing the next growth level—e.g., stalled growth, multiple viable paths, planning an experiment. Requires product-market fit; skip if no fit or a path is validated.

say_en.text: B2B payroll tool, US mid-market plateaued — go to Europe or add an SMB tier?
say_en.note: Claude triages via three questions, then recommends a path.

say_en.text: Product-market fit is solid, growth stalled — new segments or new channels first?
say_en.note: Claude maps constraint and suggests the first experiment.

say_en.text: We're weighing a new geography against a new product — how should we decide?
say_en.note: Claude compares familiarity and product-change axes.
